authorization_evidence: Current Codex task owner instruction: 配合 SWE-CI 帮助更加可控高质量的开发
explicitly_excluded: Docker images or Hugging Face datasets
OpenCode, iFlow, LLM API keys or external model calls
automatic requirement truth, signing, promotion, push or merge
acceptance_criteria: The observer is Python standard-library only and never executes verifier commands.
A manifest freezes one to five non-authoritative requirement references, exact named gates, commands, a baseline commit, an iteration budget and the verifier digest.
Requirement references only point back to the approved issue or freeze contract; the observer never declares a requirement resolved and does not become a second requirement truth source.
Evidence binds a candidate commit, manifest digest, verifier digest, offset-aware timestamps, exact named-gate results and content-addressed logs.
The R0 observer proves only schema, digest and content self-consistency; without a separately trusted producer or attestation it does not prove that the verifier actually ran.

Missing fields, extra fields, duplicate JSON keys, NaN or Infinity, duplicate IDs, truthy non-integers, manifest drift, gate-set drift, path escape, symlink traversal, digest mismatch, invalid time order and inconsistent exit codes fail closed.
Passed is derived only when every named gate is passed and the verifier exit code is exactly zero.
Mixed named-gate status precedence is error, then unknown, then failed, then passed; all-pass with nonzero exit or any non-pass with zero exit is invalid evidence.
Comparison is allowed only against the immediately preceding iteration under the same manifest and compares every gate independently, including when the previous top-level observation was not passed.
Without a comparable previous iteration, zero_regression_since_previous is null rather than true.
A comparison output binds distinct current_bundle_digest and nullable previous_bundle_digest values into an observation_digest, so different histories cannot share one comparison identity.
Evidence timestamps use RFC3339 with an explicit offset, finish is not before start, and a current iteration cannot start before the preceding iteration finished.
Manifest digest is lowercase SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=false.

artifact_root and unique log_path values are relative POSIX paths anchored at the evidence file parent and artifact root respectively; every path component is non-symlink and every gate resolves to a distinct physical log file identity.

R0 runs only on local POSIX platforms that provide race-safe dir_fd, O_DIRECTORY and O_NOFOLLOW semantics; unsupported platforms, including Windows, fail closed and are not integration targets for this slice.
The R0 exit_code contract is normalized to 0 through 255; any future Windows producer must define and test its own normalization before integration.

Output is deterministic, contains no wall-clock field, labels authenticity as unattested self-consistency only, declares automatic_gate_eligible=false, and always states that human signoff is still required.
No runtime, API, database, verifier, dependency or promotion behavior changes.
required_checks: uv run --no-project --with pytest --with jsonschema --with pyyaml --with fastapi --with httpx --with python-multipart --with 'pydantic>2' --with jieba --with openpyxl python -m pytest backend/tests/test_swe_ci_observer.py -q

uv run --no-project --with pytest --with pytest-xdist --with jsonschema --with pyyaml --with fastapi --with httpx --with python-multipart --with 'pydantic>2' --with jieba --with openpyxl python -m pytest -q -n auto
env UV_OFFLINE=1 bash scripts/verify_all.sh in a disposable verification worktree
stop_if: implementation requires executing untrusted commands or importing SWE-CI
implementation requires Docker, dataset, model, network or secret access
implementation requires a runtime schema, public API, database or state-machine change
the observer would be used as human signoff or automatic release authority
origin/main changes and affects an owned path before local completion
